created_at.description: The ISO timestamp at which the place was registered

last_updated_at.description: The ISO timestamp at which the place was last updated

401.description: The server couldn't authenticate the user

403.description: The user doesn't have the permission to perform this action

409.description: The target is still referenced in one or more deployments and cannot be deleted

500.description: The server couldn't handle the request
